content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TMC Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to report on 02 September 2026 with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess MS/DNB (Orthopedics) or MS/MD/DNB or M.Ch/DM qualification to be eligible for the Senior Resident posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident post is 40 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident role?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs.1,33,623/- to Rs.1,45,530/- per month, depending on the qualification.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the TMC Senior Resident vacancy?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly at the specified venue on the given date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Aganampudi Gajuwaka Mandalam, Visakhapatnam.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their detailed resume, passport-size photograph, and attested copies of all qualification and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Resident post is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is TMC/ADVT-141 (A)/2026.
